name: JoAi: List Addresses

description.en: List saved addresses. Without contact/team, lists the authenticated user's addresses. Pass contact or team to load that billable's billing address. Optionally filter by type.

bot: Use when the user wants to see saved billing or shipping addresses. Pass contact (hashid) to load a CRM contact's billing address, or team (slug) for a team billing address. Without either, lists the authenticated user's own addresses.

inputs.name: Type

description.en: Filter by address type: billing or shipping

inputs.bot: Optional. Pass billing or shipping to filter results.

inputs.name: Contact

description.en: Contact hashid to load that contact's billing address

inputs.bot: Pass the contact hashid to return that CRM contact's invoice/billing address.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug to load that team's billing address

inputs.bot: Pass the team slug to return that team's billing address. Do not use together with contact.
